Now a final validation pass on the updated spec (markers, counts, structure, no duplicates):

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s = open('specs/001-transactions/spec.md').read()
import re
frs = sorted(set(re.findall(r'FR-0(\d\d)', s)))
scs = sorted(set(re.findall(r'SC-0(\d\d)', s)))
as  = sorted(set(re.findall(r'\bA(\d+)\b', s)))
print('FRs:', len(frs), 'SCs:', len(scs), 'Assumptions:', len(as))
print('NEEDS CLARIFICATION count:', s.count('NEEDS CLARIFICATION'))
print('User Story 4 occurrences:', s.count('### User Story 4'))
print('Traceability table:', '## Requirement Traceability' in s)
print('R04 refs:', s.count('R04'), 'R05 refs:', s.count('R05'), 'R06 refs:', s.count('R06'))
print('superseded note present:', 'superseded' in s)
print('empty all-tags zero:', 'MUST NOT match every' in s or 'MUST remove zero entries' in s)
print('absolute expiry:', 'absolute expiry' in s)
# ensure no leftover old-scope statement
print('old A7 leftover:', 'out of scope for this milestone' in s)
c = open('specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md').read()
print('checklist unchecked boxes:', c.count('- [ ]'))
print('checklist FR-021 ref:', 'FR-021' in c)
PYEOF"}
